name: Nyírtelek (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, yellow and red in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the town arms of Nyírtelek: a crowned red shield with a yellow chevron and a hammer, above a scroll inscribed NYÍRTELEK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Nyírtelek arms with crown and scroll
